== How to create an EMF Model Project with ecore Model ==

*  1. * File-> New-> Other -> *Empty EMF Project* and give a name to your project

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/0.Select_Empty_Emf_Project_Wizard.png

<br> 

*  2. * Open UNICASE perspective and right click on the project you want to generate Ecore model from and select *Generate Ecore*

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2.GenerateEcoreModel.png

<br> 

*  3. *  Select model-Folder of your EMF Project and give name for your .ecore File

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/2.2.SelectModelFolder.png

<br> 

*  4. * Change to Java perspective and refresh your EMF Project and you see your .ecore File. Double click on your ecore file to open it in Ecore Editor.

*  5. *In Ecore Editor right click on your package and select *Load Ressource* and then click on Browse Workspace 

<br> 

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/4.Load_Source.png

<br>

*  6. * Click on *Browse Workspace* and select org.unicase.model/model/model.ecore

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/5.Select_Org_Unicase_Model.png

<br> 

== How to set properties in ecore model ==
*  7. * Go to Properties with double click on class
<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/6.Class_Properties_Select_To_Each_Class.png

<br> 

*  8. * Set to all classes ESuperTypes to UnicaseModelELement

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/7.Add_ESuper_Type_Unicase_Model_Element.png

<br> 


*  9. * Set Name to your_package_name, NS Prefix to org.unicase.model.your_package_name  and NS URI http://org.unicase.model.yourPackageName (spaces in names are not allowed)

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/Ecore_Model_Property.png

<br> 

*  10. * Right click on your package and select *Validate* from the context menu

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/8.Validate_Ecore_Model.png

<br> 


If your *Validate* was successfull you have made a correct ecore model


== How to create Gen Model from ecore Model ==

*  11. *Change to Java perspective

*  12. * File-> New-> Other -> *EMF Generator Model* 

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/9.Select_EmfGenerator_Model_Wizard.png

<br>
 
*  01. * set name for example yourEcoreModelName.genmodel 

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/10.Create_Genmodel.png

<br>

*  13. * Ecore Model (Select Model Importer) -> Next (Ecore Import) -> Browse workspace 
<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/11.Select_Model_Importer.png

<br> 

*  14. * Click on *Browse workspace* and select your ecore file

<br> 

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/12.Select_Your_Own_Ecore_FIle.png

<br> 

*  15. * Select as *Root package* only your own package

<br> 


http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/13.Package_Selection_Before.png

<br>

*  16 * Select as *Referenced Generator Model* all packages

<br> 


http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/14.Package_Selection_After.png

<br>

*  17. *Finish, your genmodel was createt


* 18. *Double click on your genmodel (root element) und you can see the properties on *Properties* View


== How to set properties in Gen Model ==

*  19. * Set in the *Properties*  All-> Base Package to org.unicase.model and click to save

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/16.Set_Properties_All-_BasePackage.png

<br> 

*  20. * Double click on package element (child element) and set in the properties these fields:
   
   *All 
      * Compilance Level - 5.0
      * Copyright Fields - true
      * Copyright Text - hier you should paste your  copyright

   * Edit
      * Edit Directory - project_name/src

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/17.All+Edit_Properties.png

<br>

   * Editor
      * Editor Directory - org.unicase.modelExample/src

   * Model
      * Containment Proxies - true
      * Model Directory - /org.unicase.modelExample/src

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/18.Editor_and_Model_Properties.png

<br>

   * Template & Merge
      * Code Formatting - true

<br>

http://unicase.googlecode.com/files/19.Template+Merge_Properties.png

<br>
